name: Theft And Thieves
overview: Scripture clearly condemns theft, as seen in the commandment 'Thou shalt not steal' (Exodus 20:15) and the severe penalty for kidnapping (Exodus 21:16). The law also prescribes restitution for stolen livestock, emphasizing accountability and justice (Exodus 22:1). The narrative of Rachel secretly taking her father's household gods (Genesis 31:19, 31:34-35) illustrates a personal instance of theft, highlighting the seriousness of such actions even within family contexts.
